questions.question: On a slippery road, you should keep a following distance that is:

options.text: The same as normal.
Greater than normal.
Closer than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Greater than normal.
questions.explanation: On a slippery road, you need more time and distance to stop. Always increase your following distance when driving on slippery surfaces.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, when should you return to your original lane?

options.text: When you can see both headlights of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.
When you have cleared the front bumper of the other vehicle.
When you are 50 feet ahead of the other vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see both headlights of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Return to your lane only when you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. This gives you enough safe distance.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangular signs mean?

options.text: School zone ahead.
Yield to other traffic.
Construction zone ahead.
Railroad crossing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to other traffic.
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. You may proceed when it is safe and the road is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep hill is ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
A logging road is ahead.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, which lane should you enter?

options.text: Any lane.
The first lane.
The second lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The first lane.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the first available legal lane. When turning from a two-way to a one-way street, turn into the first lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn, then sharp left turn.
Curves right, then left.
Curves right only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right first, then curves to the left.

questions.question: You are on a one-way street. When can you turn left onto another one-way street?

options.text: When you speed up before turning.
When traffic on that street moves to the right.
When traffic on that street moves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: When traffic on that street moves to the left.
questions.explanation: You can turn left onto a one-way street only if traffic moves to the left. You cannot turn left onto a one-way street where traffic moves to the right.

questions.question: Where is it illegal to park?

options.text: On a hill.
In a parking lot.
On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the road edge.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, you must stay within 12 inches of the road edge.

questions.question: Oncoming vehicles are to your left and parked cars are to your right. Which way should you steer?

options.text: Closer to the oncoming vehicles than the parked cars.
Closer to the parked cars than the oncoming vehicles.
Down the middle between the oncoming and parked vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Down the middle between the oncoming and parked vehicles.
questions.explanation: Steer down the middle to avoid both the oncoming traffic and the parked vehicles.

questions.question: What does a steady green light mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop and check for oncoming traffic before going.
You may drive through if the road is clear.
You may not turn right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may drive through if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you may drive through the intersection if the road is clear. You can also turn right or left unless a sign says you cannot. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians.

questions.question: You are waiting at a stop sign behind other vehicles. After the vehicles ahead pass through, if there is no cross traffic, you:

options.text: May go through without stopping again.
Must stop at the stop sign or stop line before going.
May slowly roll past the stop sign.
May follow the car ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop at the stop sign or stop line before going.
questions.explanation: You must always make a complete stop at the stop sign and check for traffic before proceeding. Do not skip this stop just because other cars are moving.

questions.question: It is best to keep a space cushion:

options.text: Only behind your vehicle.
Only on the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your vehicle on all sides. This gives you time to react to hazards. Do not drive too close to vehicles beside you.

questions.question: If you drive in fog, you should:

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Turn on your hazard lights.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when you cannot see 500 feet ahead. Low beams work best in fog. High beams reflect light back into your eyes and make it harder to see.

questions.question: For drivers 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:

options.text: 0.05 percent.
0.08 percent.
0.02 percent.
0.1 percent.

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: Adults 21 and older cannot drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop.
Merge.
Road changes direction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: Which recommendation does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Keep your windshield clean.
Know that tinted windows reduce visibility at night.
Keep a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking into oncoming headlights causes your pupils to shrink. After the car passes, your eyes need time to readjust. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: If two vehicles arrive at a four-way stop at the same time:

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
The vehicle on the right must yield to the vehicle on the left.
Drivers should make hand signals to each other.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, cars usually go in the order they arrive. If two cars arrive at the same time, the car on the left must let the car on the right go first.

questions.question: A solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line means:

options.text: Vehicles in both directions may pass.
Vehicles next to the broken line may pass.
Vehicles next to the solid line may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Vehicles next to the broken line may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line on your side means you can pass.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the side of the road with no one inside.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus shows flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop while the red lights are flashing.

questions.question: When changing lanes, check your blind spot by:

options.text: Using the inside rearview mirror.
Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.
Using your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning your head and looking over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Mirrors cannot see all blind spots. Always turn your head and look over your shoulder before changing lanes.

questions.question: What driving technique helps you avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better traction.
Leave the highways as soon as possible.
Turn on four-wheel drive.
Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snow or ice. Slowing down and increasing your distance from other cars are the best ways to avoid crashes in these conditions.

questions.question: What is the "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
A special speed zone.
A road area with rules about stereo volume.
A television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on both sides, in the back, and in the front. Your car cannot be seen in these areas. These blind spots are called the "No zone."

questions.question: Driving slower than other cars around you is:

options.text: A good idea when weather is bad.
Okay if you are not sure of the speed limit.
Often unsafe because other drivers may get frustrated and pass you dangerously.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often unsafe because other drivers may get frustrated and pass you dangerously.
questions.explanation: Driving slower than other traffic is dangerous. Drivers behind you may become impatient and take risky chances to pass you.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean?

options.text: A railroad crossing is ahead.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
No one can pass from either direction.
Anyone can pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: No one can pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass in either direction. You can only cross these lines to turn left or pass pedestrians, bike riders, or scooter/skateboard riders when it is safe and the other lane is clear.

questions.question: At a flashing red light, you should:

options.text: Slow down and give other cars the right-of-way.
Slow down and drive carefully through.
Stop completely, look both ways, then go when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, look both ways, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: Only ____ can reduce blood alcohol content (BAC) and alcohol's effects.

options.text: Drinking caffeine
Eating fatty foods
Time

questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only time can remove alcohol from your body and reduce its effects.

questions.question: Where are U-turns not allowed?

options.text: In a parking lot.
On or near curves or hills.
On a straight road where you can see 500 feet ahead in both directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: On or near curves or hills.
questions.explanation: Never turn around on or near a curve or hill. You cannot see oncoming traffic or pedestrians and may cause a crash.

questions.question: An oncoming car is on your left and a bike is on your right. You should:

options.text: Drive onto the shoulder.
Go between both of them.
Let the car pass, then pass the bike.
Pass the bike quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the bike.
questions.explanation: When there are multiple hazards, handle one at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the bike. Do not try to squeeze between both at the same time.

questions.question: What should you do at a broken traffic light?

options.text: Come to a full stop and give other cars the right-of-way.
If the intersection is clear, you do not need to stop.
Drive quickly through to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and give other cars the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: At a broken traffic light, treat it like an all-way stop. Come to a complete stop unless a police officer is directing traffic. Look and yield to others before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
A traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic light is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.
